acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using FisioVital you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, don't use the platform.

service.title: 2. The service
service.body: FisioVital connects patients with physiotherapists to book appointments, follow treatment plans and get reminders. Each physiotherapist is responsible for the clinical care they provide.

assistant.title: 3. AI assistant
assistant.body: The assistant helps with the schedule and specialists, but it does not diagnose or prescribe medication. In an emergency, call 106 (SAMU) or go to the nearest health center.

privacy.title: 4. Personal data protection
privacy.body: We process your health data only to provide the service, in accordance with Peru's Personal Data Protection Law No. 29733. You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and objection by writing to us.

ethics.title: 5. Ethical commitment
ethics.body: The team behind FisioVital follows the ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct, the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the Code of Ethics of the Engineers Association of Peru (CIP): putting public well-being first, honesty and confidentiality.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about these terms, write to soporte@fisiovital.pe.
